# Bomhound

> CycloneDX SBOM Legal Attribution & Multi-Author Copyright Engine (Apache-2.0 §4c / 17 U.S.C. § 1202).

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-Author Copyright Extraction: Parses license and notice files from upstream dependencies, extracting unabridged copyright lines and multi-author notices.
- CycloneDX Compliant: Uses official `cyclonedx-go` serializers to populate standardized `Evidence.Copyright` schemas without destroying existing SBOM properties.
- Vanity Domain Resolution: Resolves Go vanity imports (`k8s.io/*`, `golang.org/x/*`, `gopkg.in/*`) back to canonical git repositories.

## CLI Usage
- `bomhound enrich --input sbom.json --output sbom.enriched.json`: Enriches an SBOM with legal notices.
- `bomhound enrich --in-place sbom.json`: Enriches in place.
- `bomhound verify --input sbom.json`: Checks that all components possess valid copyright evidence.

## Documentation
